Prices conflict: NHL.com showed Vegas -118 and Edmonton -102, while Covers listed Edmonton -130.
discovery.question: Which moneyline price is real at books right now, and are Hyman and the Edmonton starting goalie confirmed before the 8:00 PM EST puck drop?
